title: A benchmark measures whether agents report the exceptions and stay quiet on good packs
goal: agent_bench.py gains a feedback scenario: questions with a known gap, a known retrieval miss (the kb holds the article) and a good pack, each run headless on Sonnet with the kb server; it records the share of exception runs that called kb_feedback with the right outcome and best, and the share of good-pack runs that called it at all (the false-report rate), into kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md; its --dry-run makes no paid run.
notes: Every scenario but the pool makes paid runs whatever --dry-run says (BG-wapzksub); this scenario's --dry-run must make none, and the story's own check runs no paid run.
